checks.name: Aligned import preserves blank and NULL records
Alignment rejects unequal counts, missing qids and duplicate qids
CSV preserves punctuation, actual line breaks, and literal control escapes
RSC imports full content independently of declared byte count
Dictionary parser keeps whole source terms and original line provenance
Corpus controls remain distinct and literal brackets are not variables
Source terminator handling does not stop inside sound/control arguments
Both known address corrections preserve original addresses
Legacy qid to rev2 source requires exact English evidence
RS species internal IDs are not replaced with National Dex numbers
Reviews are bound to Japanese, English and complete original candidate set
Exact complete term query publishes reviewed names and refuses prefixes
Reviewed complete battle sentence is usable without predicting an unfinished prefix
Real homographs keep species/type and type/status meanings separate
Unreviewed dialogue and dynamic templates cannot enter static runtime resources
Coverage accounts for every eligible source record in each game
Generated outputs and pinned sources match the build manifest

scope: corpus construction, source integrity and conservative static publication; not final Chinese acceptance
